limitations: Two public rendered contexts were inspected from user-provided browser captures; the captures are research evidence only and are not retained as portfolio assets.
The authenticated SCP console was not accessed.
Exact Samsung SDS color values were not sampled; theme values remain self-authored candidates.

evidence.observation: A concise Enterprise AX proposition is followed by labelled insight, case, recognition and corporate-information rails.
evidence.inference: Use declaration followed by modular evidence, not copied page styling.

evidence.observation: Enterprise claims are paired with labelled figures and distinct business-domain blocks.
evidence.inference: Bound portfolio claims with scope, responsibility or proof.

evidence.observation: The page uses a service statement, numbered feature groups, cases, catalogs and recognition.
The service catalog separates infrastructure and operations into named capability domains.
evidence.inference: Use an abstract capability taxonomy rather than a simulated console.

evidence.observation: Management, audit, log and project functions are expressed as a hierarchy with labelled operational functions.
evidence.inference: Self-authored architecture layers and ownership labels suit the portfolio.

evidence.observation: Automation capabilities are organized as numbered progression and tied to deployment, monitoring and outcome language.
evidence.inference: Use mechanism-to-outcome sequences for automation stories.

evidence.observation: Job families are grouped by professional domain with concise people-oriented supporting copy.
evidence.inference: Reserve the warmer career voice for about or closing pages.

evidence.observation: Infrastructure-role descriptions emphasize planning, building, operating, maintaining, availability, stability and efficiency.
evidence.inference: Make operating responsibility and improvement visible for a server/DevOps reader.

evidence.observation: The public portal exposes named service categories, while the authenticated console was not accessed.
evidence.inference: Use public taxonomy only as organizational evidence.

evidence.observation: SamsungOne is documented as a Samsung design-system font, without a verified portfolio/PDF embedding grant in this research.
evidence.inference: Treat SamsungOne as restricted rather than selectable.

evidence.observation: Samsung SDS identifies site trademarks, graphics, images and designs as protected materials.
evidence.inference: Portfolio must not reuse company assets or production CSS.

evidence.pageContext: IBM Plex license and Korean package
evidence.observation: IBM Plex is published under OFL-1.1 and identifies IBM Plex Sans Korean.
evidence.inference: IBM Plex Sans KR is a safe alternative candidate pending local static-file and PDF checks.

evidence.observation: User-provided browser capture of the public home shows a very large black two-line hero over a pale blue-to-lilac field, a blue-to-magenta emphasis in the second line, floating white rounded navigation controls, and compact editorial/news modules.
evidence.inference: Use decisive display scale, a restrained cool-to-violet functional emphasis, and independently authored evidence modules without reusing the hero or controls.

evidence.pageContext: Samsung SDS Cloud public product overview
evidence.observation: User-provided browser capture of the public product page shows a dark technical-image band and high-contrast navigation above a broad white content field, blue action emphasis, a large black statement, and evenly spaced customer-evidence tiles.
evidence.inference: Use deliberate contrast between a focal technical field and calm evidence space; translate customer proof into self-authored metrics or labels rather than copying logos, imagery, or carousel behavior.

visualPrinciples.name: Auditable enterprise proof
visualPrinciples.observedFact: Corporate claims are paired with figures and business-domain blocks, while the rendered home alternates an oversized statement with compact evidence modules.
visualPrinciples.abstractPrinciple: Trust comes from explicit scope and evidence rather than decorative technology signals.
visualPrinciples.portfolioDecision: Pair each project statement with a constraint, operating responsibility, metric or verified outcome.

visualPrinciples.name: Ordered operational clarity
visualPrinciples.observedFact: Cloud and automation pages use numbered feature groups and labelled functions.
visualPrinciples.abstractPrinciple: Complex systems become legible through progression and named modules.
visualPrinciples.portfolioDecision: Use numbered sequences for diagnosis, implementation and operating loops; author diagrams from portfolio facts only.

visualPrinciples.name: Capability taxonomy over simulated UI
visualPrinciples.observedFact: Public product surfaces classify cloud domains and operations explicitly.
visualPrinciples.abstractPrinciple: A scannable taxonomy can describe breadth without copying a console.
visualPrinciples.portfolioDecision: Organize architecture pages by layers, dependencies, ownership and status instead of reproducing product controls.

visualPrinciples.name: Contrast frames proof
visualPrinciples.observedFact: The rendered corporate hero uses a pale luminous field, while the rendered cloud product page places a dark technical field before a broad white evidence area.
visualPrinciples.abstractPrinciple: High contrast can mark a focal transition without making the entire system visually noisy.
visualPrinciples.portfolioDecision: Use one self-authored focal field per page, then return to calm high-contrast evidence space; do not reproduce Samsung SDS gradients, media, navigation or carousel behavior.

color.value: Use neutral high-contrast foundations with a restrained self-authored cool-to-violet emphasis; no Samsung color value is adopted.
color.rationale: Rendered corporate and product surfaces establish high-contrast black/white reading with cool and violet emphasis, but exact values are not copied or sampled.

roles.value: IBM Plex Sans KR 700 for concise display statements
roles.rationale: A licensed Korean-capable alternative supports technical clarity without selecting SamsungOne.

roles.value: IBM Plex Sans KR 400/500 for body and labels
roles.rationale: Use a small stable role set for evidence-first pages.

roles.value: IBM Plex Sans KR 500 with tabular numerals where available for metrics
roles.rationale: Metrics should remain legible and restrained.

shape.value: Use a small stable radius for controls and evidence groups, with larger radii reserved for a single focal surface.
shape.rationale: Rendered surfaces use soft rounded navigation and card-like groupings; the portfolio translates this into a smaller self-authored shape scale.

surface.value: Use calm white evidence surfaces, fine separators and one controlled focal field; floating elevation is restrained.
surface.rationale: The captures contrast broad light reading surfaces with a single darker or luminous focal field without requiring copied media.

layout.value: Use one decisive display statement, then labelled modules, numbered sequences and evidence bands with generous horizontal separation.
layout.rationale: Repeated corporate/product structure is reinforced by the rendered hero and wide product evidence field.

imagery.value: Use self-authored diagrams, abstract data fields or licensed neutral imagery only when it adds explanatory value; a dark focal field is optional, never copied product media.
imagery.rationale: Official images and screenshots are restricted, while the rendered contrast pattern can be abstracted safely.

iconography.value: Use self-authored minimal line marks or text labels with high contrast; do not reuse Samsung iconography.
iconography.rationale: Rendered navigation is simple and high-contrast, but official assets remain protected.

tone.value: Factual, stable, operator-oriented and specific about reliability, standardization and improvement.
tone.rationale: Enterprise cloud, automation and infrastructure career language consistently prioritize operating outcomes.

--theme-bg.rationale: Neutral candidate that preserves the light, high-contrast reading field without copying or sampling Samsung SDS color.

--theme-surface-strong.rationale: Subtle hierarchy without copied product styling.

--theme-line.rationale: Supports modular grouping and evidence bands.

--theme-accent.rationale: Self-authored cool technical accent informed by rendered cool emphasis; not an adopted brand blue.

--theme-accent-strong.rationale: Contrast-safe emphasis candidate for state and key evidence, independent of official color values.

--theme-accent-soft.rationale: Soft evidence grouping candidate that retains a calm light reading surface.

--theme-mono-font.rationale: Keep Korean metrics safe until a separately verified Korean mono font is selected.

--theme-radius-lg.rationale: Reserve larger grouping for explanatory surfaces.

--theme-radius-pill.rationale: Use only for status or compact labels.

--theme-shadow-floating.rationale: Subtle self-authored focus treatment; not an observed SDS shadow.

cover.value: Use one concise role statement, a small capability taxonomy and a bounded operating promise; avoid branded hero imagery.

architecture.value: Use self-authored layers, dependencies, ownership and state labels with a short legend.
architecture.rationale: Cloud Control hierarchy and cloud taxonomy.

result.value: Show one dominant verified outcome, then concise mechanism and operating context.
result.rationale: Product cases pair outcome framing with labelled modules.

closing.value: Return to reliable operation, continued improvement and role fit in restrained human language.
closing.rationale: Careers tone is useful at the narrative edge, not as product styling.

use: Use numbered process, status and evidence modules.
Use self-authored diagrams to explain infrastructure and operations.
Use concise labels and verified outcome context.
avoid: Do not copy Samsung/Samsung SDS/SCP logos, wordmarks, slogans, screenshots, diagrams, icons or production CSS.
Do not select SamsungOne or any unverified proprietary font.
Do not imitate a cloud console or infer authenticated product UI.

offLimits: Samsung, Samsung SDS and SCP logos or wordmarks
SamsungOne and any unverified proprietary typeface
Official screenshots, product UI, diagrams, photos, illustrations and icon packs
Official slogans, marketing copy and production CSS

uncertainties.claim: Exact palette values, font family/metrics, image crops and interaction behavior
uncertainties.reason: Two rendered public contexts were inspected, but no pixel sampling, font inspection or interactive behavior study was performed.
uncertainties.impact: Token values remain self-authored candidates; only the documented contrast, hierarchy, spacing and shape tendencies inform the direction.
uncertainties.resolution: Keep the current evidence bounded; independently verify local font files and final PDF behavior during application.

uncertainties.reason: The public portal was available but no login was attempted.
uncertainties.impact: No product-console interaction or visual inference is permitted.
uncertainties.resolution: Use only public official screenshots if Samsung SDS publishes them.

uncertainties.claim: SamsungOne licensing for a portfolio PDF
uncertainties.reason: No durable public embedding permission was established.
uncertainties.resolution: Keep a separately verified OFL Korean static font for any future application.
